description.value: The Ingenika Trading Post is the community general store of the Tsay Keh Dene Nation, one of British Columbia's most remote First Nations communities in the northern Rocky Mountain Trench. It serves as a one-stop shop for food, clothing, and hunting and gear supplies, and offers daily fresh food service with hot coffee and tea in an outdoor seating area. The community is accessible only by scheduled floatplane from Prince George, making this store a critical provisioning point for anyone spending extended time in the region.

address.value: 1 Main Street, Tsay Keh Dene V0J 3N0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Tsay Keh Dene Nation website is fully accessible and confirms Ingenika Trading Post is an active, operating general store with staff named, contact details, and a 2026 election news post indicating continued operations. The website explicitly lists 'Food and clothing,' 'Hunting supplies and gear,' and 'Daily fresh food services, hot drinks' as services, confirming groceries and hot food/drinks. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most other cycling amenities appears anywhere on the site; the community itself is accessible only by scheduled floatplane from Prince George, which is a significant practical concern for any cycling tourism context.
concerns: Community is accessible only by scheduled floatplane from Prince George (flights Mondays, Fridays, and one Wednesday per month) — bicycle access to this location is not feasible by road; flag for directory editors to consider how to present this listing to touring cyclists.
OSM record has no address or phone; values taken from website only.
Store description emphasizes serving 'our members' (Tsay Keh Dene Nation members), though visitors appear to be welcomed via the 'Plan Your Visit' section.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating general store confirmed by an active website with named staff and current (2026) activity. Serves as the only retail provisioning point in an extremely remote fly-in community.
enrichment_extras.notes: Additional contact: email ITP@tkdb.ca. The community accommodations site (32 beds, wi-fi, satellite TV, meals included) is referenced on the contact page for visitors arranging stays.

Hot food.detail: Website states: 'we also provide fresh food services, hot coffee, and tea daily with outdoor seating.'

wow_evidence: community general store of the Tsay Keh Dene Nation... accessible only by scheduled floatplane from Prince George
